title: “Reset now” during an outage
scenario: During a real company outage, a message in a large chat channel says IT is forcing password resets and links to an emergency portal. Colleagues are posting that they cannot access systems.

answers.A: Use the emergency link because the outage itself proves an IT incident is happening.
answers.B: Use the official IT status/help channel or identity portal you already know, not a link dropped into chat during the incident.
answers.C: Contact the help desk through a known route and ask whether password resets are part of the incident response.

explanation: Attackers exploit real incidents because users expect unusual instructions. The event may be real while the recovery link is fake.
proTip: Real outage, fake fix is still a breach.
